The plants in stages E, C, and F mainly have only stems and leaves, without obvious flowers. On the plant in stage B, small flower-like structures can be seen for the first time. The plant in stage D is larger, and green fruits or post-flower structures of subsequent development appear. Stage A has mature red fruits. Reasoning: The question asks “which label shows the plant flowering for the first time.” Along the growth sequence from left to right, the earliest stage where flowers appear is B, therefore the answer is B.
